args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service failed health checks with an error rate of about 18%. v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging. We rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is about 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying it.

trace.final:
checkout-api is healthy again on v2.3.0 in all regions, and SEV2 incident INC-0001 is open.

- **Cause:** The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with about 18% of requests failing. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also failed health checks in staging.
- **Rollback:** I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west and eu-west. That's the most recent release that was healthy in production. No approval was needed because it had been healthy in production before.
- **Check:** After the rollback, all three regions run v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate is about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure and the rollback, and it paged the on-call engineer. It also notes that someone should find the root cause before v2.3.1 is deployed again.
